description: Write or polish Traditional Chinese in concise, natural written Chinese (書面語) for Hong Kong readers. Covers docs and guides (help pages, README, product docs) and UI copy (modals, warnings, confirmations, loading states, notifications). Use when the user asks for 書面語, 精簡, 去歐化, 去 AI 化, 親切, or clearer Chinese. Not for spoken Cantonese.
